quests.title: Who Is Mondstadt's Strongest Fighter?

dialogue.t: *sigh* Shame I only get to listen in from the other side of the window and don't get to join in the debate. I'd love to give my two cents...
Say what? What's up, what's up? Paimon wants in!
Recently, all the customers at the tavern have been debating the exact same topic: "Who is the strongest fighter in Mondstadt?"
The strongest fighter?
Must be someone who can floor a whole gang of hilichurls with just one punch!

dialogue.sit: There must be far more to it than that.
Pff! I do that for fun.

dialogue.t: Wow... then it really must be tough to become the strongest of all.
But anyway... Is there, like, a general agreement in the city on who it is, or...?
Hah. Expecting people to come to a swift and straightforward consensus in the City of Freedom is like expecting Fisherman's Toast to drop out of the sky.
Everyone's got their own opinion, backed up by a unique set of cherry-picked information... But let's be honest, that's what makes the discussion so impassioned and entertaining.
Mainstream opinion is polarized, with most people supporting one of two candidates.
One is the Dandelion Knight, the other is the Darknight Hero.

dialogue.sit: Paimon, who are you voting for?
Anyone vote for me?

dialogue.t: Paimon votes for you!
But let's go into the <color=#00E1FFFF>tavern</color> and talk to the patrons. Maybe we'll pick up some juicy gossip.
Oh, I do envy your life of leisure...
But don't mind me, of course. *sigh* I guess I'll just... get back to work.
Anyone vote for me?
Pff! I do that for fun.
Then Paimon nominates you!
Who's the strongest fighter in Mondstadt?
You want to know who I think the toughest fighter is?
In my opinion, that would be the finest adventurer of them all — Stanley.
Guild Master Cyrus is up there with the toughest, too, but only Stanley can take on the bloodthirsty beasts of the Mare Jivari!
Bloodthirsty beasts of the Mare Jivari? Sounds terrifying!
D'you reckon you'd be scared if you were faced with one of those?

dialogue.sit: I'd beat it to a pulp.
I'd run for my life.

dialogue.t: Yeah! Bam, wham, pow!
I'd run for my life.
Sensible choice. Safety first and all that.
Hey, I'm doing some adventurer's training... alcohol tolerance training, to be precise... Wanna join me?
You seem to have had one too many.
Really? Let me see... eight beers, five wines, seven ciders... Not so much!
I'm no match for those legendary Mondstadt adventurers who can drink half of Cider Lake's worth of wine...
...Only a figure of speech? Really? No wonder... I could never figure out how they could afford so much wine on an adventurer's income...
What kind of liquor do you prefer?
Me...? Beer. I don't like it that much though...
It's just that... beggars can't be choosers...
As long as it gets me drunk, it's all good... Don't you agree?
Goodbye.
Laters! Happy adventuring!
Hey, I'm doing some adventurer's training... alcohol tolerance training, to be precise... Wanna join me?
Who's the strongest fighter in Mondstadt?
Er... *hic* The strongest fighter of them all?
That would be Jean, obviously! *hic*
Why? Grand Master Jean is so strong... she can take out a Ruin Guard with just a few slashes of her sword. *hic*
And she could wipe out the three hilichurl tribes at Dadaupa Gorge all by her... *hic* self.
Otherwise, we wouldn't have such a carefree existence... with nothing to do...
It's true that Jean makes people feel they're in safe hands.
Meanwhile, this guy is drunk as a skunk!
Hi! Are you here to try Mondstadt's famous wine too?
What are you doing here?
What do you mean? I'm off work...
I sleep better when I've had a little tipple after work to take the edge off.
...Huh? What difference does it make when I slack off all day anyway, you say?
Well there's nothing to do because... because Mondstadt is just so peaceful, that's why.
I'm sure my life would have been more interesting if I'd gone with the Adventurers' Guild instead...
...What makes you say that?
Just think. As an adventurer, you'd get to go explore wherever you wanted, literally anywhere in the seven nations of Teyvat...
And best of all, you can make a living from it! What could be more fun than that?
Hi! Are you here to try Mondstadt's famous wine too?
Who's the strongest fighter in Mondstadt?
The strongest fighter? I don't pay much attention to that sort of thing...
Huh. Paimon thought bartenders had some kind of special information sources.
Just like they have an exclusive supplier of wine?
Exactly! That's what Paimon was getting at.
I have no involvement in any intelligence-gathering operation.
But if you made me pick someone, it would be the Darknight Hero.
I've heard some stories about him. Apparently, he once rescued a city dweller from the Abyss Order.
There it is — the barman's top-secret intelligence!
Speaking of the Abyss Order, their minions are really stirring up trouble all over the place, aren't they?
What'll it be today?
Any recommendations?
The apple cider from the Dawn Winery is a special at Angel's Share.
You can try my special cocktail if you want. The cocktail is on the house if it's your first time here.
Tell me about yourself.
You want to know about me?
I've been working as a bartender here for more than a decade. I'm employed by the Dawn Winery, like everyone else.
I'm not that interested in alcohol, but it's my job so...
I mean, I'm not like Diona at Cat's Tail. I heard she hates alcohol.
Occasionally, Master Diluc, the owner of the winery, will cover my shift.
Days off are precious after all, so I'm very thankful to him for that.
Not right now, thanks.
Really? Shouldn't drink too much anyway, I guess.
Who's the strongest fighter in Mondstadt?
Eh? The most macho in Mondstadt?
...She's a little girlie who wears red.
A girl dressed in red?
That's right! I found this out one day about half a month ago, when I went to the Stormbearer Mountains looking for inspiration for my new song.
Guess what happened?
What happened?
I witnessed the most powerful destructive force I have ever seen in my life!
I'm telling you, it completely changed the whole landscape in that part of the mountains!
Holy moly!
I was hiding behind a bush and I saw this little girlie in red clothing running into the distance, leaving a trail of destruction in her wake.
*sigh* But I don't know if anyone will believe me.
Hmm... Now that you mention it, the idea of a tiny little girl wielding that much destructive power is a little far-fetched...
You want to know what I think? I think she has a treasure nobody else knows about.
Maybe even the most powerful treasure in all of Mondstadt!
Did you say treasure!?
{NICKNAME}, did Paimon imagine that or did you hear it too?
It's... just a guess. I mean... No, it's a bard's razor-sharp intuition!

dialogue.sit: I don't buy it.
I'll take you at your word, for now.

dialogue.t: How can you say such a thing...
So, this girl. What's her name?
Ah... I do not know her name. I do not see her often in Mondstadt.
Hey, I am telling the truth! You gotta believe me!
Hmmm... Doesn't sound like much to go on...
But thanks for your intel!
I'll take you at your word, for now.
Thank you, amigo(a)! Ah, I am so happy to meet a true amigo(a). Who would have thought—
Hey, amigo(a)!
Do you want to hear my latest composition? I put my whole heart into it, and also my soul. How about it, amigo(a)?
...Um, who are you?
You can call me Six-Fingered José, it's okay.
I am a beloved bard of Mondstadt... Or I should say, I used to be beloved.

dialogue.sit: Sing for me, José, por favor!
Are there many other bards in Mondstadt?

dialogue.t: Oh? You want to hear my latest song? I call it Ode to a Morning Breeze.
...I just need to tune my instrument.
Uh-oh...
I am so sorry. I have had no audience to play for for so long that now my strings are a little... I'll sing for you next time.
Are there many other bards in Mondstadt?
Are you kidding me, amigo(a)? Mondstadt is known all over for its songs from the pastures!
But lately a mysterious bard appeared in this place. I checked all over, but I can't find out anything about him.
Since he came here, my audience has slowly disappeared.
I did consider a battle of the bards...
But I think even I would be seduced by his beautiful voice...
Goodbye.
Leaving so soon? You are a busy bee.
If you ever have time to spare, I won't complain if you come here and show me some appreciation.
Hey, amigo(a)!
Do you want to hear my latest composition? I put my whole heart into it, and also my soul. How about it, amigo(a)?
Patton was right about one thing.

dialogue.sit: Everyone has an opinion.
Not just that, but some people's choice of candidate was just plain weird.

dialogue.t: If everyone's got their own opinion and can't be persuaded...
...How are we ever gonna find out who Mondstadt's strongest fighter is?
...Eureka! Paimon's got it!
Let's go see what <color=#00E1FFFF>Jean</color> says.
Bet the Knights have got an official ranking table for this kind of thing!

dialogue.sit: What makes you so sure?
Ooh! Do you think I'll be on there?

dialogue.t: Come on, let's just go and ask already. We'll never find out if we don't!
Ooh! Do you think I'll be on there?
Guess it depends if they counted all your shenanigans or not.
Don't worry though, Paimon has full confidence in your abilities!
Not just that, but some people's choice of candidate was just plain weird.
Oh, Master Jean! Sorry to bother you, we're collecting intel on the strongest fighter in Mondstadt.
Do you have... uh, one of those... official Knights of Favonius—verified ranking table... thingies?
Strongest fighter in Mondstadt?
I am sorry, but I cannot help. I do not have any relevant documentation on that topic...
Oh... Well, that sucks.
Paimon was hoping {NICKNAME} would at least make the top five.
Hehe. Well, although I do not have the data to make such an assessment, I will say that my faith in our Honorary Knight's abilities has never wavered.
Which reminds me...
Recently, one of the Abyss Order's Mages has been active near the city, although he is keeping a low profile.
If you are staying around Mondstadt, please be on the lookout for danger.
Given your... well, high-ranking fighting strength, I trust you will be able to help keep the area safe.
Awesome! After {NICKNAME} defeats the Abyss Order, she'll(he'll) climb up that ranking table faster than she(he) climbs up all those cliffs!

dialogue.sit: Paimon. There is no ranking table.
D'you think I'll get to first place?

dialogue.t: Well, either way, smashing the Abyss Order to bits is the right thing to do.
Hehe. I like your enthusiasm. It is infectious.
But be careful out there.
D'you think I'll get to first place?
We must investigate further to find out why the Abyss Order has been so active lately.
{NICKNAME}, please be on your guard.
I—I'm fine! I'm not hurt! Sorry for bumping into you.
You dropped something.
Hey, look, there's some writing on here...
"Explosion inside city wall, grounded be thy woe," "Explosions can hurt people, Jean can be dreadful," "Mondstadt be bombed, Klee be doomed..."
Yikes...
Mr. Kaeya wrote these down for me, um... they're, um... survival rules.
Survival rules?
Y—Yeah... Rules that I must absolutely never break under any circumstances.
Otherwise, something terrible would happen.

dialogue.sit: Kaeya writes like this?
Something terrible?

dialogue.t: Yep!
Ah, I forgot to introduce myself!
My name is Klee.

dialogue.sit: Hello, Klee.
My name is {NICKNAME}.

dialogue.t: I've heard all about you guys! You're the Honorary Knight who helps Mondstadt!
Wow!
More recognition, yay! Paimon is so happy right now.
I heard it from Amber... But wait, no— there's no time for this right now.
I'm dealing with a big emergency. I grabbed my map and ran as fast as I could all the way here.
What's wrong?
Th—The treasure I buried in the <color=#00E1FFFF>Whispering Woods</color>, it's... gone.
Did you say... buried treasure!?

dialogue.sit: I think she needs our help.
A girl dressed in red, hmm...

dialogue.t: Exactly what Paimon was thinking!
Lost treasure is a big deal. Let us help you find it!
Yay! Thanks, you guys!
Here! Here's where the map says the treasure should be. I put a circle round it.
I also put a wooden sign in the ground at the place where I buried it. To make it easier to find!
(...Paimon is starting to understand how this treasure went missing so easily.)
Come on Miss(Mr.) Honorary Knight, let's go!
A girl dressed in red, hmm...
And she has treasure!
(Seriously? Klee gets Six-Fingered José's vote for strongest fighter in Mondstadt? What is wrong with people...)
My name is {NICKNAME}.
And Paimon's name is... well, Paimon.
Something terrible?

quests.description: Customers at the Angel’s Share have started debating the hottest topic on Mondstadt’s streets: “Who is the strongest fighter in Mondstadt?”

quests.title: The Mystery of the Girl in Red's Treasure

dialogue.t: We're here! This is the place!
Look, this is where my huuuge treasure was buried...
And where there's now a huuuge empty hole in the ground...
Wait — who's that over there?
It's... an Abyss Mage!? Hey, maybe he's the one Jean was warning us about.
What's that in his hand?
My treasure!
Hmph! I see the little girl's brought her friends with her! Time for a change of plan...
Hey, you! If you think you're so tough, get back here and fight!
After him!
Game's up. Now hand it over!
Grr...
You fools think I would give this up so easily after what I have been through to acquire it?
Hehe...
Freeze!
*panting* That girl's lucky she didn't come alone, otherwise I'd...
Hmph...
A gateway to a domain! The Abyss Mage must have snuck inside.

dialogue.sit: Then he has no way out.
Let's keep up the chase.

dialogue.t: *panting* ...
Klee, do you need a rest?
Why don't you wait here while we get your treasure back for you?
...No, I'm coming with you!
It's my treasure that Mr. Fluffball stole, and it's up to me to get it back!

dialogue.sit: I admire your courage.
But these domains can be dangerous.

dialogue.t: Hee-hee, don't worry. Klee is a big girl!
Come on, Miss(Mr.) Honorary Knight! Let's goooo!
But these domains can be dangerous.
Let's keep up the chase.
Hmph. You followed me. I must say, I'm impressed.
But this is as far as you will get.
Oh yeah? What are you gonna do?
Mwuhahaha! Ahahahaha!
Oh, the human proclivity to gossip has provided us with everything we need...
We learned that your little red friend had in her possession the most powerful treasure in all of Mondstadt.
That treasure is now in my hands. There is nothing you can do!
Now your precious treasure shall be your undoing!
No, no, wait! D—Don't touch it!
Hah! Oh, how you fret now your predicament is finally clear to you!
Now, what have we here — a flame symbol? Mwuhahaha...
*bang*
NO!
I broke the survival rules... "Explosions can hurt people... Jean can be dreadful..."
This is it... This time I'm done for... *sobs*
Wait, so Klee's treasure is a bomb!?

dialogue.sit: That was epic...
It made short work of that Abyss Mage!

dialogue.t: No wonder Klee was rumored to be the strongest fighter in Mondstadt.
Paimon for one is never picking a fight with her. Ever.
Hold on... Why has she gone and run off?

dialogue.sit: Something to do with the survival rules...
Something to do with Jean...

dialogue.t: Seems like it!
Well then, let's head to the <color=#00E1FFFF>Knights' headquarters</color> and report to Jean.
Something to do with Jean...
It made short work of that Abyss Mage!

quests.description: You have heard people from various corners weigh in on who the strongest fighter in Mondstadt is, but have yet to get a definite answer. Outside the Knights headquarters, you have an unexpected meeting with one of the candidates for the title — Klee, who is in dire need of help to recover her stolen treasure.

quests.title: A Very Volatile Treasure

dialogue.t: Klee? You're here too?
I... *sobbing* I turned myself in.
...Huh?
*sobbing* I... M—My bomb... I—I hurt someone...
*sobbing* I broke the rules... I'll never see the light of day again...
Klee, I need you to answer me. You said someone was injured. Where are they?
Wait! There's been a misunderstanding.
Why is that?
The person that Klee blew up was an Abyss Mage.
But... But Mr. Fluffball was only a thief... He didn't deserve to blow up...
Hey, come on now... Paimon already told you that the Abyss Mages are the bad guys...
And actually, they're the worst kind of bad guys you can imagine. They don't just hate the good guys, they hate all people... Their enemy is... humanity itself.
Mr. Fluffball... was a bad guy on purpose? ...Mr. Fluffball is the enemy of humanity!?
Wha... what!? I don't get it!
This was an oversight on my part.
I did not tell you these things before because you are still young.
In fact, the Abyss Order is a hostile force in Mondstadt which has been unusually active lately.
Because of Mondstadt's most powerful treasure?
Aha, that's it! Paimon understands now!
They were tracking down poor Klee because they'd heard rumors about her treasure!
Just like the way Paimon's first reaction was to try and get her hands on... ahh, no— to try and get the facts on the treasure.
So... does that mean...
In light of your contribution on this matter, I will allow you to take part in the next Ludi Harpastum.
Ludi Harpastum! Whoa!

dialogue.sit: You got very lucky!
I'm so happy for you!

dialogue.t: Mr.(Miss) Honorary Knight, you've gotta come too!
Woop-de-doo, it's a happy ending!
Except...
Klee, where did you hide the treasure to begin with?
Were you trying to blow up the fish in Starfell Lake again?
I wasn't! I swear I wasn't!
(She's giving us that look that means, play along...)
(Uh-oh, Jean noticed it too...)
Klee?
I'll see myself to <color=#00E1FFFF>solitary confinement</color>... *sobbing*
Paimon bets Klee must get bored in there all by herself...
I'm so happy for you!
Guess whooo~?
That's Paimon's voice I hear!

dialogue.sit: Need help busting out of this joint?
Need a bite to eat or anything?

dialogue.t: Ooh, ooh, yes, please! Wait — no, I... I can't. Klee needs to be a good girl and think about what she did... Stop tempting me!
Anyway, while I'm grounded, I'm making an extra-special new treasure... the Ludi Harpastum version!
When you say "treasure..."
Tee-hee... I made it into the shape of a harpastum and everything! It looks so cute...

dialogue.sit: You disguised a bomb as a harpastum!?
So... another bomb?

dialogue.t: Just wait for Ludi Harpastum, oh yeah... They're gonna love it!
Yeesh, if Jean was listening to this...
Klee might find herself grounded for an awful lot longer.
So... another bomb?
Need a bite to eat or anything?

quests.description: Klee’s highly explosive “treasure” proved to be a remarkably swift solution to the Abyss Mage problem. However, she fled the scene after the explosion. Confused, you decide to return to the Knights headquarters and report the matter to Jean…
